caption:
Phed Mark 

If you listen to only one recommendation of mine about bangkok, let it be - @phedmarkbkk 

Easily one of the most popular and loved dishes throughout Thailand, pad kaprao (ผัดกะเพรา) is a combination of stir fried chilies, garlic, protein, and the most essential that distinguishes it from all other dishes - kaprao (holy basil in English) & this is the only dish they sell here!! 🥰

We tried the pork, beef and the wagyu and none of them disappointed and is something i would eat again and again and again.

in terms of chilli levels, i would say a 3 is good for any one with a decent spice tolerance. if you wanna challenge yourself a little more, do the 4 but always get that double duck egg to make it even better. do the 5 for the novelty of it, but as a spice eater, i could barely taste the food post a couple of bites lol

How to get there: take the BTS to Ekkamai and walk around 200 k and you are there :) google ji will guide the way 🥰
